design: Original TH10 Normal official trial stage 1 with stock lives, four sampled actions and no Continue. One fleet host per matched pair. First half of controller seeds plays held-ppo2 first; second half plays held-ppo5 first. Game RNG and concurrent host load uncontrolled. The 9-way movement switch rate counts every change between consecutive decisions, including neutral, within each credit.
